objects.name: Blue Fox Creature (Phase 1)
objects.where: top-left panel 'Blue Fox Creature - Model Turnaround Study': front view at left, side view (main focus) in the centre, back view at right; sheet scale 1/8, approx. 30 cm
objects.details: four-legged fox standing on all four legs; light blue fur body; cream muzzle, cheeks, chest and belly; large pointed ears, cream fur inside, dark blue rims and dark blue spiral markings on the ear backs; grey-brown eyes with dark pupils and white highlights; small black nose; slightly darker blue lower legs and paws; braided brown leather cord collar with a round deep-blue gem pendant in a silver setting; one bushy light blue tail with a cream spiral pattern and a cream tip; cream patch under the tail base
objects.budget_why: user asked to double the poly budget (was 45000, mid poly) and to spend it intelligently on details: silhouette curves, tail tufts and flame pattern, cupped ears, eyes, collar braid, gem, nose, toes

objects.name: Aethel Fox (Phase 2)
objects.where: top-right panel 'Aethel Fox (Phase 2 Evolution) - Model Turnaround Study': front view at left, side view (main focus) in the centre, back view at right; sheet scale 1/6, approx. 50 cm
objects.details: four-legged fox standing on long slim legs; light blue fur body with pale blue and faintly glowing cyan spiral markings on the flanks, shoulders, legs and tail; cream muzzle, cheeks and chest; tall pointed ears with cream fur and cream-and-blue spiral patterns inside, dark blue rims; small blue mark on the forehead; grey-blue eyes; small black nose; darker blue lower legs and paws; braided brown leather cord collar with a round deep-blue gem pendant in a silver setting; silver-white branching antler-like collar piece curving out from both sides of the neck; large plume tail curling up over the back, light blue with cream and glowing cyan spirals and a cream tip; cream patch under the tail base
objects.budget_why: user asked to double the poly budget (was 60000, mid poly) and to spend it intelligently on details: body and paws with toes, tail plume and curl, ears, antler collar scrolls, braided cord, eyes, gem

objects.name: Lumina Warden
objects.where: the whole image: a six-view turnaround study (front, front 3/4, side, back 3/4, back, top), about 100 cm
objects.details: four-legged fox standing on all four legs; light blue fur with lighter swirl markings on the face, body, legs and tails; cream muzzle, cheeks, chest and belly; darker blue lower legs and paws; very large upright ears with dark indigo inner surfaces holding light spirals and dots, cream ear tufts; blue eyes with dark lids; small dark nose and a smiling mouth line; silver branch-shaped collar across the chest with a faceted blue crystal pendant giving off blue light; feather-like fur tufts on the shoulders in lavender, cyan and mint; several large curling fur tails with blue and cream bands, dark blue undersides with small light points joined in constellation lines

style: the same art style as the reference image
